description: Header defining a templated class 'bounded_bitset' for managing a fixed-capacity, dynamically-sized bitset with support for various bit manipulations, conversions, and formatting. Includes methods for bitwise operations, slicing, iteration, and serialization, with support for different bit orderings (MSB or LSB). Also provides custom formatting for output.

classes.name: bounded_bitset
classes.description: A template class representing a fixed-capacity, dynamically-sized bitset with support for various bit operations, slicing, iteration, and formatting, configurable for bit order (MSB or LSB).

methods.name: convert_to
methods.description: Converts this bitset to another bounded_bitset type with the same size and bit order, changing only the tag.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the bitset, sanitizing bits if shrinking.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit to true or false.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all bits to false.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets all bits to true or false.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Appends a bit or multiple bits to the bitset.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a range of bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: to_uint64
methods.description: Converts the bitset to a 64-bit unsigned integer, asserting size constraints.

methods.name: from_uint64
methods.description: Loads a 64-bit unsigned integer into the bitset, asserting size constraints.

methods.name: to_packed_bits
methods.description: Converts the bitset into an array of packed bits.

methods.name: to_unpacked_bits
methods.description: Converts the bitset into an array of individual boolean bits.

methods.name: get_bit_positions
methods.description: Returns a list of positions of bits set to 1 or 0.

methods.name: find_lowest
methods.description: Finds the lowest index of a bit with a specified value.

methods.name: find_highest
methods.description: Finds the highest index of a bit with a specified value.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Checks if any bit is set to 1.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Checks if no bits are set to 1.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if bits with a specific value are contiguous.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two bitsets.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two bitsets.

methods.name: operator|=
methods.description: Bitwise OR assignment.

methods.name: operator&=
methods.description: Bitwise AND assignment.

methods.name: operator~
methods.description: Bitwise NOT (flip all bits).
